description: Verification plan of the spatial engine, architecture taalas-spatial/1 (requirements FR-VER-04). Every item is executed by sim-verilator/verify; an item it does not know is reported as not executed. Observation points are read through the host interface (READ command), not a backdoor.

items.description: Every evaluation prompt, 64 positions each: all observation points of L3 equal L2 bit for bit; the busy cycles of every step equal the fixed schedule
Reset in the middle of a step, then the sequence restarts from position 0 and matches L2
Generation from the BOS token alone matches the bundle's model of the circuits (sp_model.py)
A sequence filling the whole context (every row of the KV rings) matches the model; a step beyond the context raises `error`
A position beyond the context or a token beyond the vocabulary ends the step with `error`
A START frame with a different token and position while busy is ignored (the testbench sends one inside every step)
Bit-serial adder and row output stage at every rounding shift and width of the design: rounding ties, saturation and wrap edges, adding and subtracting
Bit-serial adder and row output stage: random operands at every rounding shift and width of the design
rmsnorm's rsqrt index unit (sp_rms_index): every sum of squares up to 2^16 times the dimension, and both sides of every power of two up to the register width
softmax's exp index unit (sp_exp_index): every difference up to the cap and beyond it
SiLU's sigmoid index unit (sp_silu_index): every int16 input
Random token sequences of the L2 trace, every position forced: all observation points of L3 equal L2
Line coverage of the chip RTL (circuits, core, host interface) over two regression prompts, a mid-inference reset and illegal inputs
